column3: BSB adds “Both of them are reminders.”
BSB follows the critical text with “your apostles” (ὑμῶν); the Textus Receptus reads “us the apostles.”
BSB follows the critical text with “scoffing” (ἐμπαιγμονῇ).
BSB renders “it is concealed from them willingly” as “they deliberately overlook.”
BSB follows the critical text with “that same word” (αὐτῷ); the Textus Receptus reads “His word.”
BSB follows the critical text with “patient with you” (ὑμᾶς); the Textus Receptus reads “toward us.”
BSB follows the critical text without “in the night” and with “will be laid bare” (εὑρεθήσεται); the Textus Receptus reads “will be burned up.” The meaning is uncertain.
BSB adds “You ought to conduct yourselves.”
BSB includes “Amen,” which the Textus Receptus adds and the critical text lacks.
